info.name: RideLink Microservices API
info.description:
IT3130 - Application Development: Postman Collection for demonstrating the RideLink Backend Microservices.

Structure:
01 Account Service
02 Driver & Vehicle Service
03 Ride Management Service
04 Fare & Payment Service
05 End-to-End Workflow
06 Negative Scenarios

Note: Endpoints are mapped to their respective service base URLs and will be populated with specific request payloads during implementation phases.

item.name: 01 Account Service
item.description: Endpoints owned by Account Service (Port 8081). Handles registration, login, JWT issuance, roles, and profile management.

item.name: 02 Driver & Vehicle Service
item.description: Endpoints owned by Driver & Vehicle Service (Port 8082). Handles vehicle details, availability status, and simulated GPS location.

item.name: 03 Ride Management Service
item.description: Endpoints owned by Ride Management Service (Port 8083). Handles ride request creation, driver assignment, and status lifecycle.

item.name: 04 Fare & Payment Service
item.description: Endpoints owned by Fare & Payment Service (Port 8084). Handles upfront fare estimates, final calculations, payments, and receipts.

item.name: 05 End-to-End Workflow
item.description: Sequential test workflow linking registration -> vehicle onboarding -> fare estimate -> ride booking -> driver assignment -> trip completion -> simulated payment and receipt generation.

item.name: 06 Negative Scenarios
item.description: Demonstrates error handling: no available driver, invalid state machine transition, unauthorized access, invalid input validation, and payment failures.
